  relRow, MATCH(name, INDEX(mods, , 1), 0),
  maxSubs, IFS( level>=241, 8, level>=201, 7, level>=161, 6, level>=141, 5, level>=101, 4, level>=41, 3, TRUE, 2 ),

LAMBDA(rarity, level, ROUND(
(
  VLOOKUP(
    SPLIT(rarity, " "),
    MOD_BASE_STAT_ARRAY,3,false
  ) + SUMPRODUCT(
    IF(level > MOD_STEPS_INCREASE_NEXT, 
      MOD_STEPS_INCREASE_NEXT - MOD_STEPS_INCREASE,
      IF(level < MOD_STEPS_INCREASE, 
        0,
        level - MOD_STEPS_INCREASE
    )),
    MOD_ARMOR_INCREASE_ARRAY
  )
)*IF(RIGHT(rarity, 1) = "*", 1 + MID(rarity, 11, 1) * 0.04, 1)+1, 3))
